paintings.title: Mona Lisa

source.file: Leonardo da Vinci - Mona Lisa (Louvre, Paris).jpg

paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art): a faithful reproduction of a two-dimensional work whose author died in 1519.
paintings.credit: Leonardo da Vinci, Mona Lisa (c. 1503–1519). Musée du Louvre, Paris. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Leonardo_da_Vinci_-_Mona_Lisa_(Louvre,_Paris).jpg
paintings.caption: A woman sits before a hazy, winding landscape, modelled with soft transitions of light and shadow.

paintings.title: The Last Supper
paintings.medium: Tempera and oil on plaster (wall painting)
paintings.holding: Santa Maria delle Grazie refectory, Milan (Museo del Cenacolo Vinciano)

source.file: Leonardo da Vinci - The Last Supper high res.jpg

paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page.
paintings.credit: Leonardo da Vinci, The Last Supper (1495–1498). Santa Maria delle Grazie refectory, Milan (Museo del Cenacolo Vinciano). Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Leonardo_da_Vinci_-_The_Last_Supper_high_res.jpg
paintings.caption: The apostles react as Christ announces that one of them will betray him. Painted directly on a refectory wall, it began to flake within decades.
paintings.notes: Store the full composition and label it as a wall painting reproduction, not a framed canvas.

paintings.title: The Birth of Venus
paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page.
paintings.credit: Sandro Botticelli, The Birth of Venus (c. 1485). Gallerie degli Uffizi, Florence. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Botticelli_Venus.jpg
paintings.caption: Venus drifts ashore on a scallop shell, blown by the winds and met by an attendant holding out a cloak.
paintings.notes: Italian cultural-heritage reproduction rules are separate and should be reviewed before commercial release; this is not an institutional open-access grant. If that is undesirable, substitute an explicitly open museum work.

paintings.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page; source attributed to Geheugen van Nederland.
paintings.credit: Johannes Vermeer, Girl with a Pearl Earring (c. 1665). Mauritshuis, The Hague. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Girl_with_a_Pearl_Earring.jpg
paintings.caption: A girl in a blue and yellow turban turns toward the viewer; light catches a large pearl at her ear.
paintings.notes: The Mauritshuis's own current image is offered for non-commercial download only; do not use it or call it CC0.

paintings.title: The Night Watch
paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page, with Rijksmuseum provenance.
paintings.credit: Rembrandt van Rijn, The Night Watch (1642). Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Nightwatch_by_Rembrandt_-_Rijksmuseum.jpg
paintings.caption: The militia company of Captain Frans Banninck Cocq sets out, its figures caught in raking light and deep shadow.
paintings.notes: Use a downsampled derivative, not the 14168 × 11528 original.

paintings.title: Las Meninas
paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page.
paintings.credit: Diego Velázquez, Las Meninas (1656). Museo Nacional del Prado, Madrid. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Las_Meninas_(1656),_by_Velazquez.jpg
paintings.caption: The young Infanta Margarita Teresa stands among her attendants while the painter works at a vast canvas; the king and queen appear in a mirror.
paintings.notes: Verify that the full composition, not a similarly named cropped detail, is imported.

paintings.title: The Starry Night
paintings.holding: The Museum of Modern Art, New York

source.file: Van Gogh - Starry Night - Google Art Project.jpg

paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art): a faithful reproduction, as stated on the file page.
paintings.credit: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night (1889). The Museum of Modern Art, New York. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg
paintings.caption: A swirling night sky rolls above a small village and a flame-like cypress, painted during Van Gogh's stay at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.
paintings.notes: Import an approved derivative with a pinned revision; the original file is about 664 MB. MoMA's wider image library is not assumed to be free to reuse.

paintings.title: Impression, Sunrise
paintings.rights: Public domain as stated on the file page: author's life plus 95 years or fewer, with a separate United States basis. Not a worldwide CC0 grant.
paintings.credit: Claude Monet, Impression, Sunrise (1872). Musée Marmottan Monet, Paris. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Monet_-_Impression,_Sunrise.jpg
paintings.caption: An orange sun rises over the hazy port of Le Havre; the title later gave the Impressionists their name.

paintings.title: Woman with a Parasol – Madame Monet and Her Son
paintings.rights: Public domain: the National Gallery of Art states that this object's media is free and in the public domain under its open-access policy.
paintings.credit: Claude Monet, Woman with a Parasol – Madame Monet and Her Son (1875). National Gallery of Art, Washington. Reproduction: https://www.nga.gov/artworks/61379-woman-parasol-madame-monet-and-her-son
paintings.caption: Camille Monet and the couple's son stand on a breezy hillside, seen from below against a bright, moving sky.

paintings.title: The Kiss
paintings.medium: Oil and gold leaf on canvas

source.file: The Kiss - Gustav Klimt - Google Cultural Institute.jpg

paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page.
paintings.credit: Gustav Klimt, The Kiss (1907–1908). Belvedere, Vienna. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Kiss_-_Gustav_Klimt_-_Google_Cultural_Institute.jpg
paintings.caption: Two lovers embrace at the edge of a flowered meadow, wrapped in patterned robes glowing with gold leaf.
paintings.notes: Do not substitute a recoloured or cropped derivative.

paintings.title: The Scream

source.file: The Scream by Edvard Munch, 1893 - Nasjonalgalleriet.png

paintings.rights: Public domain (PD-Art) as stated on the file page: author's life plus 80 years or fewer. Unrestricted status is not claimed in every jurisdiction.
paintings.credit: Edvard Munch, The Scream (1893). National Museum, Oslo (NG.M.00939). Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Scream_by_Edvard_Munch,_1893_-_Nasjonalgalleriet.png
paintings.caption: A figure on a bridge clutches its face beneath a blood-red evening sky; this is the 1893 painted version.

paintings.title: The Arnolfini Portrait
paintings.rights: Public domain as stated on the file page, sourced from Closer to Van Eyck.
paintings.credit: Jan van Eyck, The Arnolfini Portrait (1434). The National Gallery, London. Reproduction: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Arnolfini_Portrait.jpg
paintings.caption: A merchant and a woman stand hand in hand in a Bruges room; a convex mirror on the back wall reflects the whole scene.
paintings.notes: Not the tiny cropped 'Arnolfini Portrait 1.jpg' detail.

paintings.title: Water Lilies
paintings.credit: Claude Monet, Water Lilies (1906). Art Institute of Chicago. Reproduction: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/111442/water-lilies
paintings.caption: Water lilies float on Monet's garden pond at Giverny, with the sky reflected in the water.
paintings.notes: Requires is_public_domain=true, a non-empty image_id and the exact image reuse notice from the AIC API before use; the AIC website and API returned 403 from the planning and implementation environments.

paintings.title: Wheat Field with Cypresses
paintings.holding: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
paintings.rights: Public domain: The Met labels this image Public Domain under its open-access program.
paintings.credit: Vincent van Gogh, Wheat Field with Cypresses (1889). The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. Reproduction: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436535
paintings.caption: Ripe wheat bends under a churning summer sky beside a dark stand of cypresses.

paintings.title: Washington Crossing the Delaware
paintings.holding: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
paintings.rights: Public domain: The Met labels this image Public Domain under its open-access program.
paintings.credit: Emanuel Leutze, Washington Crossing the Delaware (1851). The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. Reproduction: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/11417
